Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT or THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT Francisco Gold Condominium II, EDSA cor. Mapagmahal St. Diliman, Quezon City OF THE FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT 23 OPINION April 14, 2008 MR. ROMEO O. EVARDONE, SR. punong Barangay Barangay Tomaligues, Calbayog City Dear Sir: This has reference to your letter asking whether or not your assumption as Liga ng mga Barangay (Liga) president, Calbayog City Chapter, prior to the confirmation of your succession to said position bv the National Liga ng mga Barangay, can be considered as that of a de facto officer. per your representation, based on Resolution NO. 01 Series of 2007 of the Liga of Calbayog City, and without securing prior confirmation bv the National Liga Executive Board, you assumed as President of said Liga bv succession in view of the vacancy in the Liga presidency brought about by the election of the former Liga president as regular member of the Sangguniang panglungsod. In reply to your query, may we invite your attention to section 2, Article XII of tne constitution and BV Laws (CBL) of the .Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas, viz: In case of a "Vacancies and Succession.- permanent vacancy in the office of the President due to refusal to assume office, failure to qualify, death or removal from office, voluntary resignation or incapacity to discharge functions of his/her office, the Executive Vice-President in the case of the National Liga or the Vice-President, in the case of the local Liga at all levels, shall assume the office for the unexpired term of the Succession shall take effect only after former. confirmation of the National Liga Executive Board. The Vice-President who assumed the vacant position shall represent the Liga chapter in the Sanggunian concerned." (Italics supplied) In replV thereto, mav we note that the Liga President's assumption as regular Member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of that city bv virtue of his election to said position in the 14 May 2007 national elections would result to his voluntary resignation as Punong Barangay as he is not allowed to hold two elective positions at the same time. Hence, when he cnose to

-2- assume the Sangguniang panlungsod Member position, he is deemed to have resigned his Punong Barangay position. Such being the case, he loses his right to be the Liga president since as a matter Of fact and law, he is not anymore the authorized representative to represent his barangay in the Liga ng mga Barangay City Federation. Said vacancy in the Liga presidency snall then be remedied by applying the aforequoted provision Of the Liga ng mga Barangay constitution and By Laws. It bears to emphasize that as provided in the aforequoted provision, succession shall take effect only after confirmation by the National Liga Executive Board. In your case, however, you assumed the Liga presidency and discharged the functions and duties pertaining thereto, including the ex-officio representation in the Sangguniang panlungsod without first securing the confirmation from the National Liga Executive Board. The lack of confirmation would, therefore, make your assumption procedurally but not legally defective. Hence, at most, you can be considered as a de facto Officer. A de facto Officer is one who has the reputation Of being the officer that he assumes to be, and yet is not a good officer in point of law.l The acts of the de facto public officer, insofar as they affect the public, are valid, binding and with full legal effect. The doctrine is intended not for the protection of the public officer, but for the protection Of the public and individuals who get involved in the official acts of persons discharging the duties of public Office2. AS to entitlement of salaries, were there is no de jure public officer, as in your case, the officer defacto who in good faith has had possession of the office and has discharged the duties pertaining thereto, is legally entitled to the emoluments of the office, and may, in an appropriate action, recover the salary, fees and other compensations attached to the office. we hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, AUTER A. PANADER Undersecreta Legal/l Director William C. paler cc: DILO Regional Office NO. 08 Tacloban City I Torres v. Ribo, 81 Phil 44. - Monroy v CA, 20 SCRA 620
